summary: Q3 MediaSession runtime glue. crates/quitasol-semantic gains src/runtime.rs: emit_media_session_glue lowers the Q2 Fire OS plan to deterministic Kotlin (contract QUITASOL-MEDIASESSION-RT/1-draft) — a QuitasolIntentBridge interface the app implements, and a QuitasolMediaSessionCallback with documented MediaSessionCompat.Callback overrides (onPlay/onPause, onSkipToNext, onSkipToPrevious, onFastForward, onRewind, pos==0L-guarded onSeekTo for restart) dispatching to intents by name. A callback bound by two intents is QS-E2005 (compile-time refusal); plan/scene mismatch remains QS-E2004. Intents without a documented self-serve lowering are listed as not-voice-reachable in the emitted file. The Q2 plan callback names were corrected to these API-faithful forms (onFastForward, onRewind, onSeekTo(0)). Navigation integration is recorded BLOCKED by evidence: voice scrolling and selection is back-end activated per app (Q0), not self-serve, so no navigation glue exists. The emitted Kotlin has never been compiled and no on-device behaviour is claimed.
